name: radar-stdio
description: RADAR STUDIO storefront: static site in public/, developer scripts in scripts/. Python tooling is in pyproject.toml.

scripts.lint: eslint . && ruff check scripts tests/py && mypy
scripts.test: node --test tests/ && PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/py -p "test_*.py"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test
